caseNameFull: Britt v. South Carolina and Westbury v. South Carolina
attorneys: Henry R. Sims II for petitioner Westbury. Daniel R. McLeod, Attorney General of South Carolina, Everett N. Brandon, Assistant Attorney General, and Julian S. Wolfe for respondent.

opinions.text: The applications for stays of execution presented to The Chief Justice, and by him referred to the Court, are denied.
